exposure: Induction of labor at early term (37 + 0-38 + 6 weeks)
Induction of labor at late term (39 + 0-40 + 6 weeks)
outcome: Composite maternal outcome (postpartum hemorrhage, blood products transfusion, and cesarean or instrumental delivery)
Composite neonatal outcome (neonatal intensive care unit admission, respiratory distress syndrome, hypoglycemia, and jaundice)
cohort: 430 women with singleton pregnancies and well-controlled gestational diabetes mellitus undergoing induction of labor for non-GDM indications at a single university-affiliated medical center (2014-2016)
finding: Induction of labor at early term in women with well-controlled gestational diabetes mellitus was not associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to induction at late term.
gest_age: Early term (37 + 0-38 + 6 weeks) and late term (39 + 0-40 + 6 weeks)
